title: Whole Empty Reclaim Ring and Waiting Hall
description: One static empty baggage-reclaim waiting hall, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete qualified originals preserve all original geometry, local normals, node hierarchy, opaque PBR and unit scale: the closed-plan inclined-slat reclaim ring stands independently toward the rear, an entire empty arched-platform luggage trolley stands outside its front-right perimeter, and a complete three-place station bench stands outside its front-left perimeter facing inward. A common finite floor is the only new scene geometry. Unlike the old quarter-turn conveyor/end-guide corner with a loaded trolley, this retains a complete closed ring and its open central well with separate empty peripheral waiting and trolley stations. Unlike the acceptance counter scene there is no counter, scale or luggage-handling arrangement. No new independent model, bags, conveyor movement, passenger process, access certification, operational compatibility or installation safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
